name: lette-viewings
description: AI-powered viewing slot invitations — Lette take-home challenge

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup --workspace server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
